summary: Gold calibration + eval sets: blind double-grade ~300 stratified items; frozen-work-only eval split
description: The established protocol (independent passes, disjoint contexts, key withheld, rubric verbatim from edge_relevance_judge.py). gold-cal: trainable-work queries, used for calibration/early-stop only. gold-eval: frozen-work queries ONLY, never seen in training, the number that decides. Report kappa; ABORT BAR: kappa < +0.6 means the batch is regraded, not used.
